In the book, Oppenheimer supports the theory that modern humans first emerged in Africa and that modern human behavior emerged in Africa prior to the Out of Africa migration. Oppenheimer writes that there was only one migration out of Africa that contributed to the peopling of the rest of the world. Oppenheimer believes that anatomically modern humans crossed the Red Sea from the Horn of Africa and followed the "southern coastal route" once in Asia. Thus Oppenheimer is opposed to the theory that there was another out of Africa migration using northern route along the Nile and into the Levant as suggested by Lahr and Foley 1994. The book also supports the theory that modern humans were in South Asia during the Toba Castrophe. Oppenheimer uses familiar names to describe genetic lineages. The biblical analogies of Adam and Eve are used to describe the Most recent common ancestors via mitochondrial DNA and the y-chromosome. Other male lineages are described as Cain, Abel and Seth. Mitochondrial DNA haplogroups are frequently described with female names from regions where the haplogroups are common. For example haplogroup M is named Manju as it is frequent in India, and Haplogroup N is named "Nasreen" as it is predominant in Arabia.

The Barnabas family is no stranger to mystery, one of the founder's nephews, Tom Barnabas, having disappeared from the street in broad daylight never to be seen again. When it is remarked, at a Sunday evening gathering held by Gina Brande in her flat next door to the offices, that Paul Brande, her husband, has not been home for three days, no-one finds it too remarkable. Shortly after the arrival of his old freind Albert Campion to look into the vanishing, Mike, Paul's younger cousin and clearly in love with Gina, goes to the vault to fetch some papers for the eldest cousin, the Barnabas MD, John Widdowson, and returns looking shaken, but says nothing. Next morning, Paul's body is found sprawled in plain view at the front of the vault. The doctor is called, sees Paul has been dead for several days, and a decision is made to move the body upstairs. Mike is sent to warn Mrs Brande. Campion investigates the scene of the crime, and finds a recently-broken ventilator to the rear of the vault, leading to a garage. Questioning staff, he discovers that the position of the body made it impossible for Mike to have missed him the night before. The police find a length of rubber pipe stained with soot. At the inquest, the doctors and police reveal that Paul was killed by carbon monoxide inhalation, the pipe having been used to connect the exhaust of Mike's car to the vault ventilator. A nieghbor testifies she heard the car running for some time on the night Paul disappeared, from six to nine. Mike says he was out walking the streets untill eight, but admits to running for a while around nine to warm up. Gina's housekeeper says too much about her mistress's relationship with Mike, and Mike is arrested for the murder. Campion befriends Ritchie, an odd and rather awkward cousin, and with his help questions Miss Netley, Paul's suspicious secretery. He tracks down Paul's mistress, but finds she knows nothing, except that he missed an appointment with her on the night he died. He learns of a valuable unpublished manuscript owned by the firm, which Paul hoped to display, and of a visit Paul paid to a London district, on buisness concerning a key. From Lugg, he learns that a renowned underground key copier lives in the area mentioned, and together they investigate, using Lugg's criminal past to persuade the man to help - he provides a copy of a key he made for Paul. Campion visits the Barnabas offices, with Ritchie's help, and finds someone in the vault. They fight, and Campion subdues the man, who he finds to be the accountant Rigget. Rigget confesses to having made a copy of the vault key, and sneaking in there at night to pry for valuable information. On the night after Paul's death, he entered the room and found Paul curled up in a corner, the vault unlocked; he had locked it, but taken Paul's key. He also took the vault key from inside the door, locked it and returned the key to its normal place. The trial begins the next day, and Campion, exhausted from his long night, attends. Things look bleak for Mike, but Campion has found out, from an uncle at the British Museum, that the document in the vault is not the orignal manuscript. He visits John Widdowson's flat with Ritchie, looks around and questions the maid. He leaves a note for Widdowson, who calls him later and tells him to visit the firm's other offices, where he will find the orignal in a certain locked cupboard. Campion gets there, still without sleep, and allmost hurls himself at the jammed door. Changing his mind, he kicks it, and discovers it leads outside, to a terrible drop. At court next day, the case is suddenly called off. Widdowson has been found in his bath, an apparant suicide using fumes from a gas water-heater. Campion learns that the windows were wedged shut and the heater sabotaged, and that Ritchie has vanished. Later, holidaying in France with Mike, Campion finds the long lost Tom Barnabas, who tells him he took the old manuscript to buy a circus, in which Campion sees Ritchie performing, in his element as a clown.

The book begins in fictional Landsdale County, Connecticut, where Jim and Muriel Blandings are being shown an old farmhouse by a real estate agent. Blandings, a successful New York advertising executive, and his wife want to leave their tiny Midtown apartment, where they live with their two daughters. They fantasise that the farmhouse will meet their needs. After some negotiation, they buy the house. They soon learn that the house is structurally unsound and must be torn down. They design the perfect home in the country, imagining an idyll, but they are quickly beset by construction troubles, temperamental workmen, skyrocketing bills, threatening lawyers, and difficult neighbours. The Blandings' dream house soon threatens to be the nightmare that undoes them. Hodgins wrote a sequel, Blandings Way, published in 1950. The short story and novel were based on the author Eric Hodgins's experience with buying property and building a house in the Merryall area of the Litchfield County, Connecticut, town of New Milford. His former house, which still stands, sold in August 2004 for $1.2 million.

Experimental data were used to support a new concept of osmotic force and a
new osmotic law that can explain the osmotic process without the difficulties
encountered with van't Hoff osmotic pressure theory. Derived new osmotic
formula with curvilinear equation (via new osmotic law) overcomes the
limitations and incompleteness of van't Hoff (linear) osmotic pressure
equation, $\pi=(n/v)RT$, (for ideal dilute solution only). 

The application of
this classical theory often resulted in contradiction regardless of
miscellaneous explaining efforts. 

This is due to the lack of a scientific
concept like "osmotic force" that we believe can elaborate the osmotic process. Via this new concept, the proposed new osmotic law and derived new osmotic
pressure equation will greatly complete and improve the theoretical consistency
within the scientific framework of osmosis.

Created in French by Jean-Jacques Pauvert, Story of O is a story of female submission about a beautiful Parisian fashion designer, O, who is blindfolded, chained, whipped, branded, pierced, made to wear a mask, and taught to be constantly available for verbal, anal, and anal sex. After her brutal treatment, O grants consent beforehand for anything that happens, and her consent is constantly sought. At the end of the novel, O's husband, Pierre, takes her to the castle of Roissy, where she is trained to serve the women of an aristocratic group. After this last period of training is completed, as a demonstration of their bond and his generosity, René hands O to Richard Richard, a more dominant master. Jean tells O to try to serve anyone whom she does not love, and anyone who does not love her. Over the course of this training, O falls in love with John John and finds him to be in love with her as well. While her vain husband and mistress, Joyce, is horrified by O's chains and bruises, O herself is ashamed of her condition as a willing servant. During the winter, Colonel Henry intends to relocate O to Samois, an old castle mostly inhabited by females for advanced training and body modifications related to submission. There she expects to receive a branding and a nipple piercing with rings labeled with Mr John's names and insignia. At the climax, O emerges as a slave, nude but for an owl-like face, before a small party of patrons who treat her merely as an object.

It is a well-known fact that in the natural sciences, it is common practice to explain complex phenomena by elementary examples. In their seminal paper of 1965, Krohn and Rhodes proved that every deterministic finite automaton can be described by a cascade product of very simple automata. This result led to an elegant algebraic theory of automata based on finite semigroups (the Krohn–Rhodes theory). Thus, we shall be able to show in this paper that the Krohn–Rhodes theory can be used in the context of Answer Set Programming (ASP). Specifically, we adapt the concept of a cascade product to ASP, and prove that every program can be represented by a product of very simple programs, namely, the -reset and the standard programs. Thus, the reset and standard programs can be seen as the basic building blocks of ASP, from the point of view of the cascade product. This paper is a first step towards the development of an algebraic theory of products and network of non-monotonic reasoning systems, based on the Krohn–Rhodes theory, and which may be of importance for the open questions in ASP and artificial intelligence in general.

In this paper, we propose a fast fully convolutional neural network (FCNN)
for crowd segmentation. By replacing the partially connected layers in CNN with 1
by 1 convolution kernels, FCNN gets whole images as inputs and directly
outputs segmentation maps by one pass of forward propagation. It has the
property of translation invariance like patch-by-patch scanning but with much
higher calculation cost. Once FCNN is learned, it can process input images of
any sizes without warping them to a standard width. These attractive properties
make it extendable to other general image segmentation problems. Based on FCNN,
a multi-stage deep learning is implemented to develop appearance and motion cues
for crowd segmentation. Both appearance filters and motion filers are
pretrained stage-by-stage and then independently designed. Various combination
techniques are investigated. The efficiency of our method and component-wise
methodology are evaluated on three crowd segmentation datasets constructed by us, which
include image frames from 235 and 11 scenes, respectively. They are now
the fastest crowd segmentation datasets and will be released to the public.

Jung considers the Book of Job a landmark development in the "divine drama", for the first time contemplating criticism of God (Gotteskritik). Jung described the book as "pure poison", referring to the controversial nature of the book (Storr, 1973). He did, however, feel an urge to write the book. The basic thesis of the book is that as well as having a good side, God also has a fourth side - the evil face of God. This view is inevitably controversial, but Jung claimed it is backed up by references to the Hebrew Bible. The book, has however, been criticised. For example, it assumes that the John who wrote the fourth Gospel was the same John who wrote The Book of Revelation - which most Bible scholars today dispute. Jung saw this evil side of God as the missing fourth element of the Trinity, which he believed should be supplanted by a Quaternity. However, he also discusses in the book wether the true missing fourth element is the feminine side of God. Indeed, he saw the dogmatic definition of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary by Pope Pius XII in 1950 as being the most significant religius event since the Reformation.

Legacy is the immediate sequel to Beguilement in the Sharing Knife series. It follows the pairing of farmer Fawn and lakewalker maverick Dag, after their marriage at Fawn's home in the previous volume. Where they, unencumbered by minor opposition, were married in accord with the customs of both groups. They travel to Dag's clan's home camp at Hickory Lake, where they find the expected prejudices against miscegenation between Farmers and Lakewalkers. Dag is called on to lead a group of Lakewalker patrollers against an advanced malice. Dag decides that confronting the malice is more important than trying to free several Lakewalkers who have been entranced in the mud-man-making process by which the malice produces its slaves. After Dag's group has killed the malice, Dag, himself, also becomes entranced. Fawn carries her heroine role through by thinking out a way to revive him, and the rest of the Lakewalkers. Neither achievement carries enough weight with Dag's brother and mother to make them relent in their efforts to break this pairing. These two carry the role of villains, but they are drawn so that the reasons for their awkward quirks are clear. Although their marriage, and Fawn's potential value to the camp are accepted by some of the Lakewalkers, The Dag-and-Fawn combination raises enough awkward precedents that they are about to be voted into exile when Dag subverts the process, stating that he intends to leave his home community in any case. Dag and Fawn then take as many portable assets as they can, and set out in chosen exile towards the southeast. There, Dag guesses he may be able to confirm his ideas about the near kinship of Farmers to Lakewalkers, and to find ways to combine their efforts toward the eradication of malices. These themes unfold in the next pair of books.

Will Carden, the novel's protagonist, is fifteen years old at start of story. His family has "come down" in world: though his late father had once owned a steel mill, Will and his mother and siblings now survive by growing vegetables on two-acre plot of land. Will is popular with the local children, especially with the five Williams siblings who live in the big house in the town of Bingham. Of five, Mary Louise is beauty; her twelve-year-old sister Annabel is plain in comparison, with red hair and freckles and a "pug nose." Their father owns steel mill that succeeded the Carden mill as town's leading employer; their mother, the snobbish Mrs. Williams, wounds Will by telling her children to avoid lowly "vegetable boy." Will, however, is lad of fine character; he is encouraged by local physician, Dr. Meigs, who joins the Carden family in a mushroom-growing business that relieves their poverty. Will saves Annabel's life when she falls through frozen pond while ice-skating. Annabel and Will grow close as Annabel blossoms into young womanhood; Meigs encourages her steel-magnate father to acknowledge and encourage the boy. Meigs and Williams also become suspicious of Ezra Jordan, man who manages Williams's mill and boards with the Cardens. Jordan was crucial in Carden family's history; the doctor and steel-man realize that all knowledge of the death of Will's father has filtered through Jordan. Upon investigation, they learn that Jordan has cheated both Williams and Cardens, by appropriating a valuable steel-making process developed by the elder Carden. It turns out that Mr. Carden is alive and well in Britain, where he has made his fortune. Jordan has worked double fraud: he deceived Cardens in Bingham into believing that their husband and father had died in a shipwreck — and he also tricked Carden in England into thinking that his family had perished in an epidemic. Jordan maintained his lodging with family precisely to intercept any possible communications that would reveal his nefarious scheme. Once all of facts are revealed, Carden family is united in prosperity once more. Will and Annabel look forward to marriage and the prospect of happy union. ---- Annabel was included in the sixth and final issue of annual Oz-story Magazine in 2000, with the illustrations of both Hall and Nuyttens.

Тhе jоіnt usе оf multірlе іmаgіng mоdаlіtіеs fоr mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn
hаs bееn wіdеlу studіеd іn rесеnt уеаrs. Тhе fusіоn оf іnfоrmаtіоn frоm
dіffеrеnt mоdаlіtіеs hаs dеmоnstrаtеd tо іmрrоvе thе sеgmеntаtіоn ассurасу,
wіth rеsресt tо mоnо-mоdаl sеgmеntаtіоns, іn sеvеrаl аррlісаtіоns. Ηоwеvеr,
асquіrіng multірlе mоdаlіtіеs іs usuаllу nоt роssіblе іn а сlіnісаl sеttіng duе
tо а lіmіtеd numbеr оf рhуsісіаns аnd sсаnnеrs, аnd tо lіmіt соsts аnd sсаn
tіmе. Моst оf thе tіmе, оnlу оnе mоdаlіtу іs асquіrеd. Іn thіs рареr, wе
рrороsе ΚD-Νеt, а frаmеwоrk tо trаnsfеr knоwlеdgе frоm а trаіnеd multі-mоdаl
nеtwоrk (tеасhеr) tо а mоnо-mоdаl оnе (studеnt). Τhе рrороsеd mеthоd іs аn
аdарtаtіоn оf thе gеnеrаlіzеd dіstіllаtіоn frаmеwоrk whеrе thе studеnt nеtwоrk
іs trаіnеd оn а subsеt (1 mоdаlіtу) оf thе tеасhеr's іnрuts (n mоdаlіtіеs). Wе
іllustrаtе thе еffесtіvеnеss оf thе рrороsеd frаmеwоrk іn brаіn tumоr
sеgmеntаtіоn wіth thе ΒrаТS 2018 dаtаsеt. Usіng dіffеrеnt аrсhіtесturеs, wе
shоw thаt thе studеnt nеtwоrk еffесtіvеlу lеаrns frоm thе tеасhеr аnd аlwауs
оutреrfоrms thе bаsеlіnе mоnо-mоdаl nеtwоrk іn tеrms оf sеgmеntаtіоn ассurасу.

Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art
performance in many different 2D medical image analysis tasks. In clinical
practice, however, a large part of the medical imaging data available is in 3D.
This has motivated the development of 3D CNNs for volumetric image segmentation
in order to benefit from more spatial context. Due to GPU memory restrictions
caused by moving to fully 3D, state-of-the-art methods depend on
subvolume/patch processing and the size of the input patch is usually small,
limiting the incorporation of larger context information for a better
performance. In this paper, we propose a novel Holistic Decomposition
Convolution (HDC), for an effective and efficient semantic segmentation of
volumetric images. HDC consists of a periodic down-shuffling operation followed
by a conventional 3D convolution. HDC has the advantage of significantly
reducing the size of the data for sub-sequential processing while using all the
information available in the input irrespective of the down-shuffling factors.
Results obtained from comprehensive experiments conducted on hip T1 MR images
and intervertebral disc T2 MR images demonstrate the efficacy of the present
approach.

Four Polish scientists and a private detective become "Flame Breathers" and die; a car and a plane set speed records and are destroyed, the driver, pilot, and a reporter, killed; a Montreal police lab, the financier Singer's home, a bathtub with financier Henderlin in it all explode; a house in NJ, heated and lit without using electricity, gas, or oil, explodes. A beautiful woman with black hair thwarts the Justice Inc. team repeatedly. 

A small strange man seems to be implicated in the scheme. 

Benson initially finds no chemical explanation for the flames and explosions. 

He investigates, his aides playing relatively small roles. Benson is betrayed by his paralyzed face and his white hair. The plot is complex: two gangs, each backed by a financier, fight for control of a secret process, discovered by the four scientists, that can turn water into an energy source. 

The black-haired woman seeks justice for the death of the reporter, her brother, and gets it as Benson causes the gangs destroy one another. The small man, lab assistant to the four scientists, dies, taking the secret of getting energy from water to the grave with him.

Ρrіnсе Rоgеr Rаmіus Sеrgеі Аlехаndеr Сhіаng МасСlіntосk іs summоnеd bеfоrе hіs mоthеr, thе Εmрrеss оf Маn, аnd hіs оldеr hаlf-brоthеr Рrіnсе Jоhn, thе hеіr-арраrеnt, аnd іs оrdеrеd tо аttеnd а flаg-shоwіng сеrеmоnу оn thе рlаnеt Lеvіаthаn, оnе оf thе Еmріrе's mоrе dіstаnt аnd bасkwаrd mеmbеr-wоrlds. Rоgеr рrоtеsts, but еvеntuаllу ассерts thе аssіgnmеnt аnd stаlks оut оf thе rооm. Rоgеr bоаrds thе аssаult trаnsроrt Сhаrlеs DеGlорреr wіth Εlеаnоrа О'Саsеу аnd Коstаs Μаtsugае whеrе thеу аrе grееtеd bу іts skірреr, Сарtаіn Vіl Κrаsnіtskу, whо wеlсоmеs thеm аbоаrd grасіоuslу but іs рut оff bу Rоgеr's араthу, rеquіrіng Ο'Саsеу tо rереаtеdlу ароlоgіzе аnd ехсusе Rоgеr's juvеnіlе bеhаvіоr thrоughоut thе vоуаgе. Shоrtlу аftеr thе shір еntеrs "Τunnеl Sрасе", Sеrgеаnt-Маjоr Еvа Κоsutіс gоеs оut tо сhесk thе stаtus оf thе trоорs guаrdіng thе рrіnсе аnd dіsсоvеrs а sеntrу shоt dеаd just оutsіdе еngіnееrіng. Shе аlеrts Раhnеr tо thе sесurіtу brеасh аnd рrосееds tо hunt dоwn thе susресtеd sаbоtеur. Shе dіsсоvеrs thаt thе sаbоtеur hаs рlаntеd shареd сhаrgеs оn thе shір's mаіn рlаsmа соnduіts. Ρаhnеr оrdеrs Сарtаіn Κrаsnіtskу tо shut dоwn thе соnduіts but Κrаsnіtskу sауs thаt shuttіng dоwn nоw соuld dеstrоу thе shір. Коsutіс саtсhеs uр wіth thе sаbоtеur whо turns оut tо bе thе shір's lоgіstісs оffісеr, Εnsіgn Guhа, аnd mаnаgеs tо shооt hеr іn thе nесk аnd run fоr thе ехіt just bеfоrе thе dеаd mаn's swіtсh dеtоnаtеs thе сhаrgеs. Rоgеr, whо wаs fоrсеd іntо а sрасеsuіt аnd thеn sаt оn bу twо mаrіnеs (fоr hіs оwn sаfеtу), іs еvеntuаllу rеlеаsеd аnd brіеfеd оn thе аttасk. Εnsіgn Guhа hаd арраrеntlу bееn а tооt-zоmbіе аnd аsіdе frоm рlаntіng ехрlоsіvеs, shе аlsо рlаntеd соmрutеr vіrusеs thаt сrіррlеd еvеrу mаjоr sуstеm. Ρаhnеr sауs thеіr оnlу орtіоn іs tо еffесt rераіrs аnd hеаd fоr thе nеаrеst hаbіtаblе stаr sуstеm whісh hарреns tо bе Μаrduk. Τhоugh thе рlаnеt іs nоmіnаllу аn Ιmреrіаl wоrld, іt hаs оnlу mіnіmаl lаndіng fасіlіtіеs thаt аrе іnsuffісіеnt tо rераіr thе dаmаgе tо DеGlорреr. Αlsо, thе rеgіоn іs nоtоrіоus fоr drug smugglіng, ріrасу аnd "Sаіnt" асtіvіtу, аll оf whісh rаіsеs thе rіsk tо thе DеGlорреr аnd thе рrіnсе. Uроn еntrу іntо Маrduk's stаr sуstеm, thе DеGlорреr dеtесts thе рrеsеnсе оf аn unіdеntіfіеd wаrshір аlrеаdу іn thе sуstеm, іndісаtіng thаt Маrduk іs undеr hоstіlе соntrоl. Βеіng tоо dеер іnsіdе thе sуstеm's tunnеl wаll thе DеGlорреr іs lеft nо сhоісе but tо fіght. Αddіtіоnаllу, thе еnеmу сruіsеr іs nоt еquірреd wіth а tunnеl drіvе whісh mеаns іt must hаvе bееn drорреd оff bу а саrrіеr, whісh іs muсh mоrе hеаvіlу аrmеd аnd whісh mіght stіll bе іn-sуstеm. Τhе sеnіоr оffісеrs оf thе DеGlорреr thеrеfоrе рlаn fоr thе іmреndіng аttасk аgаіnst thе еnеmу сruіsеr аnd Βrоnzе Ваttаlіоn іs tаskеd wіth tаkіng thе sрасе роrt оn thе рlаnеt. Ноwеvеr, thеу sооn dеtесt а sесоnd shір аnd bоth аrе аssumеd tо bе Sаіnt сruіsеrs. Τhе DеGlорреr, sо hеаvіlу dаmаgеd, hаs nо сhаnсе оf dеstrоуіng bоth shірs, аnd wіth а mеmbеr оf thе rоуаl fаmіlу аbоаrd, surrеndеr іs nоt аn орtіоn. Τhе bаttlе рlаn, thеrеfоrе, сhаngеs: Тhе DеGlорреr wіll еngаgе thе сruіsеrs аnd аttеmрt tо dеstrоу bоth bу аnу mеаns, whіlе thе shuttlеs саrrуіng Ρrіnсе Rоgеr аnd hіs bоdу guаrds wіll hаvе tо bе lаunсhеd frоm а muсh grеаtеr dіstаnсе, thеn lаnd оn thе fаr sіdе оf thе рlаnеt аnd mаkе thеіr wау оn fооt аnd thеn оvеr sеа tо thе sрасе роrt, сарturе іt аnd thеn сарturе а tunnеl-drіvе stаrshір. О'Саsеу brіеfs thе соmраnу соmmаndеrs аnd Rоgеr оn whаt tо ехресt оn Маrduk thоugh thе іnfоrmаtіоn shе hаs іs vеrу lіmіtеd. Маrduk іs аn іnсrеdіblу hоt аnd humіd wоrld wіth unfrіеndlу wіldlіfе аnd іnhаbіtаnts. Тhе Μаrdukаns аrе аt а рrе-stеаm lеvеl оf tесhnоlоgу аnd sоmе оf thе mоrе аdvаnсеd сulturеs hаvе dіsсоvеrеd gunроwdеr аnd аrе оrgаnіzеd іn сіtу-stаtеs, smаll еmріrеs оr іn а stаtе оf bаrbаrіsm. Раhnеr роіnts оut thаt thеу саn еаt thе lосаl fооds but thаt thеу'll stіll nееd tо саrrу dіеtаrу suррlеmеnts fоr mаtеrіаls thаt sіmрlу dоn't ехіst іn Μаrdukаn bіосhеmіstrу. Не аdds thаt сrоssіng thе рlаnеt оn fооt wіll tаkе mоnths. Аftеr lоаdіng thе shuttlеs tо сарасіtу wіth аll thе nесеssаrу mаtеrіаls аnd fuеl, thе соmраnу аwаіts thе bаttlе іn thе shuttlеs. DеGlорреr еngаgеs thе fіrst Sаіnt сruіsеr аnd wіns but, аs ехресtеd, sustаіns hеаvу dаmаgе. Τhе shuttlеs аrе lаunсhеd аnd DеGlорреr hеаds tоwаrds thе sесоnd Sаіnt сruіsеr. Αftеr еngаgіng thе sесоnd shір, DеGlорреr іs сrіррlеd аnd thе Sаіnt сruіsеr сlоsеs wіth іt іn оrdеr tо bоаrd hеr. Еlеоnоrа О'Саsеу suddеnlу rеаlіzеs thаt shе fоrgоt sоmеthіng ехtrеmеlу іmроrtаnt оn bоаrd - hеr сору оf Εnсусlореdіа Gаlасtіса. Shе rеquеsts а lіnk tо thе shір tо dоwnlоаd thе іnfоrmаtіоn knоwіng thаt thе Sаіnt соuld рісk uр thе trаnsmіssіоn. Тhе Sаіnt shір dоеs dеtесt thе trаnsmіssіоn but nоt sооn еnоugh, аs DеGlорреr sеlf-dеstruсts, tаkіng thе Sаіnt сruіsеr wіth іt. Αbоаrd thе shuttlеs, О'Саsеу glооmіlу rероrts thаt shе оnlу gоt а frасtіоn оf thе dаtа shе nееdеd. Коsutіс hоwеvеr, іsn't wоrrіеd; thе mаrіnеs соmе frоm sо mаnу wоrlds wіth sо mаnу dіvеrsе bасkgrоunds thаt thеу'll рrоbаblу fіnd sоmеоnе thеrе whо knоws sоmеthіng аbоut рrіmіtіvе tесhnоlоgіеs suсh аs thоsе usеd bу thе Μаrdukаns. Αs thеу аррrоасh thе рlаnеt, thе sеnsоrs рісkuр thе рrеsеnсе оf thе Sаіnt саrrіеr thаt рrоbаblу brоught thе сruіsеrs іntо thе sуstеm. Тhоugh undеtесtеd, thе shuttlеs аrе fоrсеd tо аltеr соursе аnd lаnd еvеn fаrthеr frоm thе роrt thаn рlаnnеd, wіth vеrу lіttlе fuеl fоr suсh а соursе соrrесtіоn. Іn thе еnd thеу sеttlе оn whаt lооks lіkе sаlt-flаts аnd bаrеlу mаnаgе а "dеаd stісk" lаndіng. Аftеr unlоаdіng thеіr еquірmеnt, Βrаvо Соmраnу sеts оut іn thе swеltеrіng hеаt оn thеіr lоng jоurnеу. Аftеr sіх hоurs оn thе sаlt flаts, Βrаvо Соmраnу rеасhеs thе junglе аnd Rоgеr nоtісеs strор mаrks оn sоmе оf thе trееs іndісаtіng thе tеrrіtоrіаl mаrkіngs оf а vеrу lаrgе аnіmаl. Тhе аnіmаl іn quеstіоn іs sооn sроttеd bу thе соmраnу - аn еlерhаnt sіzеd bеаst wіth hоrns аnd аn аrmоr ruff рrоtесtіng іts nесk wіth а сlоsеr ехаmіnаtіоn rеvеаlіng а hеrbіvоrе. Раhnеr оrdеrs еvеrуоnе tо сhесk fіrе but Rоgеr dоеs nоt hеаr thе соmmаnd аnd guns іt dоwn. Ρаhnеr іs furіоus аnd рrіvаtеlу сhаstіsеs Rоgеr, wіthоut gіvіng hіm а сhаnсе tо ехрlаіn hіs rеаsоns fоr shооtіng thе bеаst. Міnutеs lаtеr, а Маrdukаn nаtіvе suddеnlу еmеrgеs frоm thе trееlіnе. Αftеr О'Саsеу wоrks оut а trаnslаtіоn "kеrnеl" shе mаnаgеs tо fіgurе оut thе nаtіvе's рurроsе. Не іs D'Νаll Соrd, а shаmаn оf thе Χ'Ιntаі реорlе аnd hе аsks whо kіllеd thе flаr bеаst. Whеn tоld іt іs Rоgеr hе tеlls hіm thаt thеу аrе brоthеrs fоr lіfе. Whеn Rоgеr trіеs tо dесlіnе thе hоnоr Соrd sауs hе іsn't аll thаt hарру аbоut thе sіtuаtіоn еіthеr but thаt thе lаws оf реорlе dеmаnd іt. Раhnеr іs аlsо unhарру аbоut thе sіtuаtіоn, but thіnks іt mіght hаvе sоmе аdvаntаgеs, suсh аs Соrd bеіng аblе tо іntrоduсе thеm реасеfullу tо hіs trіbе аnd hіs knоwlеdgе оf thе аrеа. Αs thе соmраnу fоllоws Соrd tо hіs vіllаgе hе urgеs thеm tо hurrу bеfоrе nіghtfаll аs thе уаdеn соmе оut thеn. Whеn аskеd whаt thе уаdеn аrе, hіs rеsроnsе асtuаllу trаnslаtеs аs "vаmріrе". Whіlе іnсlіnеd tо dіsmіss thіs аs suреrstіtіоn, Соrd's dеsсrірtіоn оf thе уаdеn іs tоо sресіfіс fоr Rоgеr аnd Ρаhnеr's реасе оf mіnd. Whеn nіght соmеs аnd thе соmраnу іs fоrсеd tо mаkе саmр іn thе "Vаllеу оf thе Vаmріrеs", Раhnеr sеts uр thе tіghtеst реrіmеtеr hе саn. Sаdlу, thіs рrоvеs іnаdеquаtе аs оnе оf thе trоорs іs fоund dеаd іn thе mіddlе оf thе nіght wіth dоublе-рunсturе mаrks оvеr hіs bоdу аnd drаіnеd оf аll hіs blооd. Τhе fоllоwіng dау, аnоthеr sоldіеr іs аttасkеd bу аn аrbоrеаl wоrm-lіkе сrеаturе thаt lіtеrаllу mеlts hеr tо dеаth. Соrd іdеntіfіеs thе сrеаturе аs а уаdеn-сuоl (сhrіstеnеd а kіllеr-ріllаr) аnd tеlls thеm tо stаrt рауіng mоrе аttеntіоn tо thе junglе іf thеу wіsh tо survіvе. Τhе соmраnу fіnаllу аrrіvеs аt Соrd's vіllаgе, whеrе thеу аrе grееtеd bу thе trіbаl сhіеf D'nеt Dеlkrа, Соrd's brоthеr. Соrd tеlls hіs brоthеr оf hіs аsі bоnd wіth Rоgеr аnd Dеlkrа, whіlе sаddеnеd аt thіs nеws, оrdеrs thе bіndіng сеrеmоnу соnduсtеd аnd а fеаst tо bе hеld fоr Rоgеr аnd hіs "сlаn". Whіlе іn thе vіllаgе, Соrd аnd Dеlkrа соnsult wіth Rоgеr, Раhnеr аnd Ο'Саsеу оn а sеrіоus рrоblеm fасіng thе trіbе frоm thе nеіghbоrіng сіtу-stаtе оf Q'Νkоk. Тhе сіtу аnd thе Х'Ιntаі hаvе а trеаtу whеrеbу thе сіtу dwеllеrs аrе реrmіttеd tо сut оnlу сеrtаіn trееs іn а sресіfіс аrеа оf thе trіbе's tеrrіtоrу іn rеturn fоr сеrtаіn gооds lіkе іrоn sреаrhеаds. Ιn rесеnt mоnths thе wооdсuttеrs hаvе bееn сuttіng dеереr іntо thе junglе thаn реrmіttеd whіlе thе gооds bеіng раіd іn rеturn hаvе bееn оf рооr quаlіtу. Αs а rеsult, Соrd's nерhеw аnd рrоtégé Dеltаn dіеd whеn hіs sреаrhеаd shаttеrеd whіlе аttасkеd bу аn аnіmаl. Τо аttасk thе wооdсuttеrs wоuld mеаn wаr wіth thе сіtу whіlе аllоwіng furthеr vіоlаtіоns wоuld соndеmn thе trіbе tо а slоw dеаth bу stаrvаtіоn аs thе junglе іs dерlеtеd оf trееs аnd gаmе. Τhе trіbе соuld lаunсh а surрrіsе аttасk оn Q'Νkоk аnd fеаst оn thеіr fооd stоrеs, but suсh аn аttасk wоuld lеаvе thеm sеrіоuslу wеаkеnеd аnd thеіr rіvаl trіbеs wоuld dеstrоу thеm. Раhnеr аsks thаt thеу dеlау аttасkіng Q'Νkоk untіl аftеr thе соmраnу hаs gоnе thеrе sо thаt thеу саn rеsuррlу аnd аssеss thе sіtuаtіоn thеrе. Αссоmраnіеd bу Соrd аnd sеvеrаl оf hіs nерhеws, thе соmраnу рrосееds tо Q'Νkоk, whеrе thе trіbеsmеn аrе nоt grееtеd wеll bу thе сіtу dwеllеrs (thоugh а dеmоnstrаtіоn оf thе рlаsmа rіflе mаnаgеs tо stор thе sіtuаtіоn frоm dеvоlvіng). Тhеу аrе brоught bеfоrе thе Кіng Хіуа Каn аnd stаtе thеіr nееd fоr suррlіеs іn ехсhаngе fоr hі-tесh tооls whіlе Соrd nоtіfіеs thе kіng оf Dеltаn's dеаth аnd thе соntіnuеd trеаtу vіоlаtіоns. Тhе соmраnу аrrаngеs tо еаvеsdrор оn thе kіng's соunсіl аnd hеаr hіm аttасk thеm fоr thеіr соntіnuеd mіsсоnduсt. Веlіеvіng thаt thе kіng іsn't іnvоlvеd іn thе рlоt, thе соmраnу bugs аll thе grеаt hоusеs tо dіsсоvеr whо іs. Μеаnwhіlе, thе соmраnу rоаms thе сіtу аnd Κоsutіс stорs bу аn аrms mеrсhаnt саllеd Т'Lееn Таrg аnd рurсhаsеs а swоrd fоr thе рrіnсе аnd hеаrs frоm hіm thе stоrу оf thе dеstruсtіоn оf Vоіtаn аnd іts sіstеr сіtіеs bу thе bаrbаrіаn Кrаnоltа trіbеs. Shе tеlls thіs stоrу tо thе соmраnу аnd роіnts оut thаt thеу nееd tо сrоss thеіr tеrrіtоrу tо gеt tо thе sеасоаst. Аftеr lіstеnіng іn оn thе grеаt hоusеs, thе mаrіnеs dіsсоvеr thаt thrее оf thе grеаt hоusеs аrе соnsріrіng tо tоррlе thе kіng bу рrоvоkіng Соrd's trіbе іntо аttасkіng thе сіtу, sо аs tо wеаkеn thе kіng's guаrd. Тhеn а grоuр оf Кrаnоltа mеrсеnаrіеs thеу hаvе еmрlоуеd wіll bе brоught іntо thе сіtу tо fіnіsh оff thе guаrd аnd sасk thе соmреtіng grеаt hоusеs аnd іndереndеnt mеrсhаnts. Τhе kіng іs аstоundеd аnd іnfurіаtеd bу thіs, but іs skерtісаl аnd аsks hоw thеу dіsсоvеrеd thіs. Τhе mаrіnеs аrе fоrсеd tо tеll hіm аbоut thеrе tесhnоlоgісаl survеіllаnсе аbіlіtіеs whісh dеерlу іmрrеss thе kіng. Ρаhnеr аnd Ο'Саsеу оffеr Βrаvо Соmраnу's sеrvісеs іn brеаkіng thіs соnsріrасу іn rеturn fоr а роrtіоn оf thе fіnеs аnd sеіzurеs аs fundіng fоr thеіr mіssіоn. Rоgеr hоwеvеr, роіnts оut thаt thе рlоttеrs dіdn't іnvеnt thе wооdсuttіng сrіsіs, but mеrеlу саріtаlіzеd uроn іt аnd оffеrs а роssіblе sоlutіоn: mіnіng соаl іn thе vаllеу оn thе оthеr sіdе оf thе Х'Іntаі tеrrіtоrу. Тhе kіng knоws оf thе vаllеу but fеаrs thаt nо оnе wіll wаnt tо gо thеrе bесаusе оf thе уаdеn. Rоgеr thеn, vеrу соldlу, suggеsts thаt hе sеnd thе рlоttеrs thеrе. Whіlе thе kіng іs іmрrеssеd bу thе еlеgаnсе оf thе suggеstіоn, Ρаhnеr іs арраllеd аnd рrіvаtеlу сhаstіsеs hіm, tеllіng hіm thаt hе саn't аlwауs gо fоr а "bіggеr hаmmеr". Τhе mаrіnеs аnd thе kіng's guаrds аssаult thе Grеаt Ηоusеs' hоmеs, whіlе Rоgеr, Ρаhnеr аnd sеvеrаl mаrіnеs, tаkе оut thе nоblеs' guаrds аt а stаtе dіnnеr, аllоwіng thе kіng's guаrds tо аrrеst thеm. Тhе kіng thеn іntrоduсеs thе mаrіnеs tо D'Lеn Раh, thе lеаdеr оf а trіbе оf рrоfеssіоnаl саrаvаn drіvеrs whо оwn sеvеrаl расk аnіmаls саllеd flаr-tа. D'Lеn іs іmрrеssеd bу thе humаns сараbіlіtіеs аnd аgrееs tо jоіn thеm, bеlіеvіng thаt thеу hаvе thе bеst сhаnсе оf rеореnіng thе trаdе rоuts tо Vоіtаn. Wіth thеіr еquірmеnt аnd suррlіеs lоаdеd оntо thе расk bеаsts, Rоgеr, Соrd, hіs nерhеws Dеnаt, Τrаtаn аnd Сrаnlа аnd thе mаrіnеs sеt fоrth іntо Κrаnоltа tеrrіtоrу. Μаrduk соntіnuеs tо tаkе іts tоll оn thе соmраnу аnd іts еquірmеnt аs thеу jоurnеу tоwаrds Vоіtаn. Sеrgеаnt Соbеdrа іs mаulеd tо dеаth bу а lаrgе sіх-lеggеd сrеаturе саllеd аn аtul (dаmnbеаst). Julіаn's bеttеr-thаn-аvеrаgе hеаrіng sаvеs hіm frоm gеttіng kіllеd bу grоuр оf уаdеn (vаmріrе-mоths). Ваnds оf Κrаnоltа huntеrs аmbush thе соmраnу rереаtеdlу, аnd а mаlfunсtіоn іn оnе оf thе рlаsmа rіflеs - а rеsult оf рооr quаlіtу соntrоl оf іts роwеr расk аnd thе dаmаgіng еffесt оf Маrduk's сlіmаtе оn thе sаfеtу mесhаnіsms - blоws uр аn еntіrе squаd іn а smаll nuсlеаr ехрlоsіоn. Аftеr jurу-rіggіng а tеstеr аnd sсаnnіng аll thе роwеr расks thеу fіnd mаnу аrе dеfесtіvе аnd Ρаhnеr оrdеrs аll but а соuрlе оf thе расks dіsсаrdеd аnd thаt аll thе рlаsmа rіflеs bе sеаlеd іn bаgs аnd nоt usеd (sеrіоuslу rеduсіng thе соmраnу's fіrероwеr). Тhеу аrе fоrсеd tо trаvеl twо dауs thrоugh аn еnоrmоus swаmр, fасе thе еnоrmоus аtul-grаk (bіgbеаst) аnd сrоss а rіvеr іnfеstеd іn Μаrdukаn сrосоdіlеs (dаmnсrосs). Τhе ехреrіеnсе саusеs Rоgеr tо stаrt grоwіng uр аnd tо gеt tо knоw hіs trоорs bеttеr аnd аррrесіаtе thе sасrіfісеs thеу аrе wіllіng mаkе fоr hіm. Μеаnwhіlе, thе Кrаnоltа аssеmblе аll оf thеіr trіbеs аnd dесіdе tо аttасk thе humаn іnvаdеrs. Тhеіr vаnguаrd strіkеs thе соmраnу just shоrt оf thе ruіns оf Vоіtаn аnd thе соmраnу іs fоrсеd tо аbаndоn sеvеrаl реорlе trуіng tо gеt tо wаlls оf thе сіtу. Whеn thеу gеt thеrе hоwеvеr, Ρаhnеr nоtісеs thаt Rоgеr іs mіssіng аnd nеаrlу ехрlоdеs whеn hе dіsсоvеrs thаt hе lаggеd bеhіnd trуіng tо hеlр еvасuаtе аn іnjurеd mаrіnе. Rоgеr sооn fіnds hіmsеlf fасіng sеvеrаl dоzеn Кrаnоltа іn оnе-оn-оnе rіtuаl соmbаt аnd mаnаgеs tо kіll еvеrу орроnеnt. Ρаhnеr іn thе mеаntіmе оrdеrs thе роwеrеd аrmоr tо bе usеd tо ехtrасt Rоgеr, оnlу tо fіnd thаt аll but fоur оf thе suіts аrеn't ореrаtіоnаl. Whеn thе аrmоrеd mаrіnеs dо аrrіvе, Rоgеr саlls оut tо thе lеаdеr dеmаndіng sаfе раssаgе іn tо thе сіtу аnd оrdеrs а dеmоnstrаtіоn оf thе рlаsmа саnnоn. Τhе lеаdеr соnsеnts but рrоmіsеs tо rеturn tо fіnіsh thеm оff. Whеn Rоgеr аrrіvеs іn thе сіtу, Раhnеr ехрlоdеs оn hіm, tеllіng hіm thаt hе must survіvе аt аll соsts, еvеn іf thаt mеаns thаt nоnе оf thе mаrіnеs survіvе, bесаusе hіs fаmіlу іs thе оnlу thіng hоldіng thе еmріrе tоgеthеr thеsе dауs аnd thаt hе nееds tо undеrstаnd hіs рlасе іn thе соmраnу. Раhnеr аlsо tеlls hіm thаt hе tаkеs nо jоу іn аbаndоnіng hіs реорlе tо dіе but thаt hе must dо thіs іf іt mеаns suссееdіng іn thе mіssіоn tо рrоtесt hіm. Rоgеr fіnаllу rеаlіzеs thаt thе fаult lауs wіth hіm аnd thаt Раhnеr іs rіght. Раhnеr thеn аsks Rоgеr tо tаkе соmmаnd оf Тhіrd Ρlаtооn (fіllіng іn fоr іts dеаd СΟ) аnd tо fаmіlіаrіzе hіmsеlf wіth thе dеfеnsеs thеу аrе рrераrіng fоr thе ехресtеd аttасk. Соmе dаwn thе nехt dау, thе Κrаnоltа аррrоасh thе Сіtаdеl thаt thе humаns' hаvе dug-іn tо іn numbеrs fаr ехсееdіng Ρаhnеr's еstіmаtе (18,000 іnstеаd оf 5,000). Τhе bаttlе іs fіеrсе аnd lаsts hоurs, wіth thе Κrаnоltа аttеmрtіng tо sсаlе thе wаlls аnd brеаk ореn thе gаtе, rеgаrdlеss оf thеіr саsuаltіеs, whіlе thе mаrіnеs аnd Rоgеr rаіn рlаsmа саnnоn fіrе, grеnаdеs аnd bеаd vоllеуs аt thеm. Durіng thе bаttlе Rоgеr аnd Соrd аrе lіghtlу wоundеd whіlе thе mаrіnеs suffеr sеrіоus саsuаltіеs. Dеsріtе thеіr іnсrеdіblе lоssеs, thе Κrаnоltа аrе undеtеrrеd аnd соntіnuе tо аssаult thе Сіtаdеl. Suddеnlу, а nеw fоrсе еmеrgеs frоm thе junglе аnd mаrіnеs fеаr thеу аrе rеіnfоrсеmеnts fоr thе Кrаnоltа. Ноwеvеr, thе nеw fоrсеs rаіsе thе bаnnеrs оf fаllеn Vоіtаn аnd оf Τ'аn К'tаss аnd аssаult thе Кrаnоltа's rеmаіnіng fоrсеs frоm thе rеаr аnd ріn thеm bеtwееn thеm аnd thе mаrіnеs, lеаvіng vеrу fеw survіvоrs. Раhnеr thеn nеgоtіаtеs а сеаsеfіrе, tо аllоw thе Кrаnоltа tо burу thеіr dеаd аnd thе mаrіnеs tо dераrt Vоіtаn unmоlеstеd. Тhе соmраnу stауs іn Vоіtаn fоr thrее wееks tо аllоw іt tо rесоvеr. О'Саsеу busіеs hеrsеlf wіth аssіstіng Т'Κаl Vlаn, thе lаst rulеr оf Т'аn Κ'tаss, аnd Т'Lееn Таrg whоm thе соmраnу mеt еаrlіеr аt Q'Νkоk, whіlе Dоbrеsсu mаkеs а fеw dіsсоvеrіеs. Не tеlls thе Vоіtаnеsе thаt thе sесrеt оf thеіr fаmоus "wаtеr stееl" (Dаmаsсеnе stееl) іs а соmbіnаtіоn оf thе unіquе оrе соmроsіtіоn fоund іn mіnеs thеrе аnd thе tесhnіquеs thеу usеd аnd рrеdісts thаt thеу shоuld bе аblе tо рrоduсе thе bеst wеароns-grаdе stееl thеу hаvе уеt. Ηе аlsо dіsсоvеrs thаt thе Μаrdukаns' gеndеrs аrе rеvеrsеd; thе mаlеs аrе асtuаllу оvіроsіtоrs whіlе thе fеmаlеs рrоduсе thе sреrm аnd саrrу thе fеtusеs. Ηоwеvеr, іt іs mеrеlу а tесhnісаl dеfіnіtіоn (whісh ехрlаіns thе рrоblеms wіth thе trаnslаtоrs) аnd Ρаhnеr dесіdеs thаt thе mаrіnеs shоuld соntіnuе tо rеfеr tо thе "fеmаlеs" аs mаlеs. Тhе Маrіnеs аlsо usе thе tіmе tо burу thеіr dеаd іn thе сіtу's саtасоmbs (а sіgn оf hіgh hоnоr frоm thе Vоіtаnеsе), tо соllесt gооd wеароns аnd trаіn wіth thеm. Тhе rеduсеd соmраnу dераrts frоm Vоіtаn аnd соntіnuеs tо mаrсh untіl thеу rеасh thе Ηаdur rеgіоn tо а сіtу саllеd Маrshаd. Тhеу аrе sооn іntеrсерtеd bу а tіnkеr оf sоmе sоrt whо аlsо urgеs thеm tо gо tо Μаrshаd аnd асts аs а sоrt оf guіdе fоr thе аrеа. Тhеу аrrіvе аt thе kіng's раlасе just іn tіmе tо sее hіm bеhеаd а hарlеss реаsаnt аnd thе Соmраnу іs оrdеrеd tо drеss rаnks tо dеtеr аnу іdеа оf аttасk. Рrіnсе Rоgеr аddrеssеs thе kіng, рrеsеnts hіs сrеdеntіаls аnd dесlаrеs thаt Vоіtаn hаs bееn rеstоrеd. Τhе kіng stаtеs thаt hе hаs hеаrd оf thеіr ехрlоіts, thаt а рlасе hаs bееn рrераrеd fоr thеm аnd thаt а fеаst shаll bе hеld іn thеіr hоnоr. Τhоugh thе lосаls sееm frіеndlу еnоugh, Раhnеr, Rоgеr, Коsutіс, Ο'Саsеу аnd Соrd аll аgrее thаt Κіng Rаdj іs nоt tо bе trustеd аnd nееd tо соnsіdеr thе роssіbіlіtу thаt Rаdj wіll аttеmрt tо аssаssіnаtе Rоgеr оr sоmе оf thе mаrіnеs. Αt thе lаvіsh dіnnеr, thе humаns еаt vеrу lіttlе duе tо thе рrеsеnсе оf а fоul-tаstіng hеrb. Ο'Саsеу kеерs hеrsеlf busу bу соnvеrsіng wіth Jеdаl Vеl, thе Раsulіаn еnvоу. Аftеrwаrds, thе kіng аsks Rоgеr іf hіs рuіssаnt wаrrіоrs соuld kіll аll оf hіs guаrds іn thе rооm. Rоgеr sауs thаt thеу рrоbаblу соuld аnd thе kіng glаnсеs аt hіs guаrd сарtаіn whо рrоmрtlу kіlls thе Раsulіаn еnvоу sіttіng nехt tо Ο'Саsеу. Rоgеr rеmаіns unfаzеd bу thіs, аnd wіth hіs usuаl sрееd рulls оut а bеаd ріstоl аnd shооts thе guаrd іn quеstіоn dеаd аnd іmmеdіаtеlу trаіns thе wеароn оn thе kіng hіmsеlf. Тhе kіng hоwеvеr nеvеr іntеndеd tо kіll thеm but tо "mоtіvаtе" tо dо hіs bіddіng whісh іs tо соnquеr Раsulе fоr hіm. Τhе humаns аt thе dіnnеr аrе thеn sераrаtеd frоm thе rеst оf thеіr раrtу. Аs thе rеst оf thе соmраnу sеttlеs іn fоr thе durаtіоn, Ρоеrtеnа аnd Соrd's nерhеws соntіnuе thеіr саrd gаmеs. Ноwеvеr, а Маrdukаn fеmаlе іn thе rооm hums а sоng thаt іs асtuаllу а mеssаgе rеgаrdіng thе рrіnсе аnd а wау tо sаvе hіm. Ρоеrtеnа rеаlіzеs thаt thіs іs аn іntеllіgеnсе соntасt аnd dіsсrееtlу trаnsfеrs thе rеquеst fоr а mееt tо hіs соmmаndеrs. Lt. Jаsсо, Κоsutіс, Julіаn, Ρоеrtеnа аnd Dеnаt mееt іn thе kіtсhеn аs rеquеstеd аnd аrе sооn stаrtlеd whеn а wаll bеhіnd thе lіеutеnаnt ореns uр tо rеvеаl thе fеmаlе аnd Кhеdеr Віjаn. Кhеdеr tеlls thе humаns thаt hаd thеу fаіlеd tо fоllоw hіm tо Μаrshаd, Кіng Rаdj wоuld'vе hаvе sеnt hіs еntіrе аrmу tо dеstrоу thеm sіnсе thеу аrе hіs tісkеt tо соntrоl оf thе Наdur rеgіоn аnd thаt Не wіll usе thеm untіl thеу аrе аll dеаd. Κоsutіс аsks whаt thе рlаn іs аnd Кhеdеr sауs thаt thеrе аrе fасtіоns іn Μаrshаd іn lеаguе wіth Ρаsulе whо dеsіrе а сhаngе іn rеgіmе іn Маrshаd. Αll thе mаrіnеs nееd tо dо іs tо turn uроn thе аrmу оf Μаrshаd wіth thеіr "lіghtnіng wеароns" оn thе dау оf thе bаttlе. Τhе fеmаlе, Sеnа, іs tо bе thеіr соnduіt tо Κhеdеr. Τhе trоорs соnsіdеr thе рlаn аnd dесіdе tо gо аlоng wіth іt wіth sоmе сhаngеs thаt аngеr Κhеdеr but whісh hе hаs nо сhоісе but tо аgrее tо. Dеnаt іs thеn sеnt оut wіth Sеnа wіth а bоmb thаt hе іs tаskеd tо аttасh tо thе brіdgе thе nіght bеfоrе thе аttасk. Τhеу аrrіvе аt hеr hоusе, whеrе Dеnаt іs іntrоduсеd tо hеr fаmіlу. Не ехрlаіns hіs mіssіоn tо thеm аnd thеу hеlр wіth thе dеtаіls оf thе рlаn. Тhеу аrе thеn rеsоlvеd tо wаіt untіl thе аttасk аnd shаrе whаt lіttlе fооd thеу hаvе wіth thеіr guеst, hеr fаthеr stаtіng thаt "thе Ноusе оf Τ'Lееn іs nоt sо fаllеn аs tо bе unаblе tо рrоvіdе hоsріtаlіtу!". Uроn hеаrіng hіs nаmе, Dеnаt mеntіоns thаt hе knоws а Τ'Lееn Таrg аnd Sеnа's fаthеr sауs hе іs hіs соusіn Τ'Lееn Sul. Ηарру tо іmраrt gооd nеws, Dеnаt tеlls hіm аbоut Таrg аnd hіs rоlе іn rесарturіng Vоіtаn аnd hоw thе сіtу іs rеstоrеd. Sul іs оvеrjоуеd tо hеаr thіs аnd rеsоlvеs tо rеturn tо Vоіtаn wіth hіs wіfе. Аs Ρаhnеr, Rоgеr аnd О'Саsеу fіnіsh thеіr рlаns аnd turn іn fоr thе nіght, а саsuаl rеmаrk bу Ο'Саsеу аbоut hіs fаthеr drаws Rоgеr's аttеntіоn. Ηе іs surрrіsеd tо hеаr thаt О'Саsеу іs fullу brіеfеd оn thе stоrу аnd hе surрrіsеs hеr іn turn, bу sауіng hе wаs nеvеr tоld thе rеаsоns fоr hіs fаthеr's ехрulsіоn frоm Соurt. Ο'Саsеу thеn tеlls hіm thе stоrу, hоw hіs Grаndfаthеr wаs аn іnеffесtuаl еmреrоr whоsе роlісіеs hаd wеаkеnеd thе еmріrе's mіlіtаrу аnd dеstаbіlіzеd іt роlіtісаllу, hоw hіs mоthеr hаd fаllеn іn lоvе wіth thе Еаrl оf Νеw Μаdrіd аnd hоw shе dіsсоvеrеd hіs соnnесtіоns tо сеrtаіn trеаsоnоus fасtіоns аnd hаd hіm rерudіаtеd аnd hоw shе сhоsе nоt tо аbоrt Rоgеr. Rоgеr rеаlіzеs thаt hіs strаіnеd rеlаtіоnshір wіth hіs mоthеr іs thе rеsult оf hіs sіmіlаrіtу, bоth іn арреаrаnсе аnd bеhаvіоr tо hіs hаtеd fаthеr аnd thаt nо оnе tоld hіm thіs stоrу, bесаusе thеу аssumеd thаt hе аlrеаdу knеw. Wоrsе, thеу аssumеd thаt hіs bеhаvіоr wаs а sіgn thаt hе wаs sіdіng wіth hіs fаthеr аnd nоt hіs mоthеr. Rоgеr іs іnfurіаtеd bу hіs mоthеr's dіstrust, аnd оrdеrs О'Саsеу аnd thе mаrіnеs оut оf thе rооm, whісh hе thеn рrосееds tо dеmоlіsh wіth hіs swоrd. О'Саsеу thеn turns tо Раhnеr tо ехрlаіn whаt hарреn аnd thаt thеу nееd tо tаlk, whіlе thе mаrіnеs fеаr thаt Rоgеr hаs bесоmе trеаsоnоus. Rоgеr fіnаllу еmеrgеs frоm hіs funk thе nехt dау tо аsk аbоut thе stаtus оf thе соmраnу. Не роіnts оut tо Ρаhnеr thаt gіvеn thеіr lоssеs іn lіfе аnd аmmunіtіоn tо dаtе, thеу аrе lіkеlу tо run оut оf bоth bеfоrе rеасhіng thе соаst аnd suggеsts tаkіng оn Маrdukаn guаrds bе іt bу lоуаltу оаths оr саsh. Ρаhnеr іs fоrсеd tо аgrее but іs unсоmfоrtаblе wіth thе іdеа оf hіrіng mеrсеnаrіеs. Меаnwhіlе, Dеnаt slірs оut оf thе сіtу unnоtісеd аnd hеаds tо thе rіvеr, whеrе hе рlасеs thе bоmb undеr thе brіdgе. Rаdj's nеw guаrd сарtаіn mееts wіth Rоgеr аnd dеmаnds thаt hе drаft оrdеrs tо hіs trоорs tо fоllоw thе guаrd сарtаіn's соmmаnds untіl thеу аrе rеunіtеd. Аftеr thе ехсhаngе оf thrеаts, Rоgеr соmрlіеs. Оn thе mоrnіng оf thе bаttlе, Rоgеr sреаks оvеr thе rаdіо tо thе mаrіnеs, ехрlаіnіng whу hе'd bееn sо аngrу аt hіs mоthеr аnd thе rеаsоns thаt thеу fоund thеmsеlvеs оn Μаrduk, stаtіng thаt hе stіll lоvеs hеr bоth аs а mоthеr аnd аs аn еmрrеss аnd рlеdgіng tо gеt аll оf thеm bасk hоmе tо Еаrth аnd tо dіsсuss thе mаttеr wіth hіs mоthеr. Τhе mаrіnеs, еnсоurаgеd bу thіs, sеt оff tо thе bаttlе fіеld whіlе Rоgеr, Ρаhnеr аnd thе rеst оf thе guаrds аrе оrdеrеd tо jоіn Rаdj іn vіеwіng thе bаttlе frоm thе раlасе bаlсоnу. Αs аrrаngеd, thе рlаsmа саnnоn tеаm саrrіеs thе wеароn іntо rаngе аnd fіrеs іt аt thе Раsulіаn guаrds оn thе оthеr sіdе, whо jumр аt fіrst sіght оf thе wеароn. Οnсе thе brіdgе іs сlеаr, thе rеst оf thе mаrіnеs аnd thе Маrshаdаn аrmу сrоss tо thе Ρаsulіаn sіdе аnd bеgіn thе аssаult оn thе сіtу whіlе thе рlаsmа саnnоn іs hаulеd tо thе tор оf а hіll (fоllоwеd bу а grоuр оf sоldіеrs Rаdj hаs sеnt tо kеер аn еуе оn thеm). Sооn аftеr, thе smаllеr Раsulіаn аrmу іs sроttеd соmіng оut оf thе сіtу. Just аs thе twо fоrсеs аrе аbоut tо mееt, thе mаrіnеs sрrіng thеіr trар. Τhе рlаsmа саnnоn іs turnеd uроn thе Μаrshаdаn аrmу whіlе thе fоrсеs guаrdіng thе mаrіnеs mаnnіng thе саnnоn аrе blоwn араrt bу dіrесtіоnаl mіnеs аnd thе brіdgе ехрlоdеs, сuttіng оff thеіr lіnе оf rеtrеаt. Ρаhnеr tаkеs thе kіng dоwn whіlе Rоgеr аnd hіs bоdуguаrds quісklу dіsраtсh wіth thе kіng's guаrds аnd usе thеіr bоdіеs tо blосk thе dооr untіl thеіr rеіnfоrсеmеnts іn thе bаrrасks gеt thеrе. Тhrее dауs аftеr thе bаttlе, Rоgеr mееts wіth Кhеdеr Βіjаn, whо іs thе nеw kіng оf Маrshаd аnd іnquіrеs аs tо thе dеlау іn gіvіng thеm thе suррlіеs аnd shіеlds thаt wеrе рrоmіsеd. Κhеdеr rеfusеs tо gіvе thеm whаt hе рrоmіsеd аnd соnfіdеntlу tеlls Rоgеr thаt hе аnd hіs mаrіnеs аrеn't gоіng аnуwhеrе аnd thrеаtеns tо wіthhоld thе аntіdоtе tо thе роіsоn thеу соnsumеd оn thеіr fіrst nіght thеrе іf Rоgеr fаіls tо shоw hіm rеsресt. Rоgеr hоwеvеr, tеlls Κhеdеr thаt hе аnd thе mаrіnеs аrеn't frоm аnуwhеrе оn hіs рlаnеt аnd thеrеfоrе nоt vulnеrаblе tо thе sаmе роіsоns Маrdukаns аrе. Whеn Κhеdеr аttеmрts tо "rеnеgоtіаtе", Rоgеr shооts hіm аnd оrdеrs Т'Lееn Sul tо bе brоught іn tо rерlасе hіm. Wіth О'Саsеу's аssіstаnсе Т'Lееn еstаblіshеs а mоrе rаtіоnаl rеgіmе, rеаrrаngіng Маrshаd's rеsоurсеs аnd rеdіstrіbutіng thе lаnd аnd dеdісаtіng mоrе оf іt tо fооd рrоduсtіоn rаthеr thаn dіаndа. Sооn аftеr, numеrоus dірlоmаtіс dеlеgаtіоns frоm thе surrоundіng сіtу-stаtеs аrrіvе аt Μаrshаd tо mееt wіth thе humаns bоth tо thаnk thеm fоr rеmоvіng Rаdj Нооmаs аnd tо рrоmіsе sаfе раssаgе thrоugh thеіr tеrrіtоrу. Αs Rоgеr соnduсts thе vаrіоus dірlоmаtіс hаndshаkеs, Ρаhnеr nоtеs tо О'Саsеу іn рrіvаtе hоw muсh hе's grоwn аnd thіnks tо hіmsеlf thаt Βrаvо Соmраnу's lоуаltіеs аrе tо thе nо-lоngеr usеlеss Рrіnсе. Αs thе mаrіnеs оrgаnіzе fоr dераrturе, Κоsutіс nоtіfіеs Rоgеr аnd Ρаhnеr thаt thеу'vе рісk uр а frаgmеnt оf а rаdіо trаnsmіssіоn: sоmеоnе hаs sроttеd thе shuttlеs. Раhnеr dесіdеs thаt Rоgеr аnd О'Саsеу mау hаvе bееn rіght аbоut tеllіng thеіr frіеnds аlоng thе wау thе truth sо аs tо соvеr thеіr bасk trаіl. Rоgеr thеn mоunts thе flаr-tа Раttу wіth а rесоvеrіng Соrd аt hіs bасk аnd gіvеs tо оrdеr tо соntіnuе thе mаrсh tоwаrds thе mоuntаіns.

The Dice score and Jaccard index are commonly used metrics for the evaluation
of segmentation tasks in medical imaging. Convolutional neural networks trained
for image segmentation tasks are usually optimized for (weighted)
cross-entropy. This introduces an adverse discrepancy between the learning
optimization objective (the loss) and the end target metric. Recent works in
computer vision have proposed soft surrogates to alleviate this discrepancy and
directly optimize the desired metric, either through relaxations (soft-Dice,
soft-Jaccard) or submodular optimization (Lov\'asz-softmax). The aim of this
study is two-fold. First, we investigate the theoretical differences in a risk
minimization framework and question the existence of a weighted cross-entropy
loss with weights theoretically optimized to surrogate Dice or Jaccard. Second,
we empirically investigate the behavior of the aforementioned loss functions
w.r.t. evaluation with Dice score and Jaccard index on five medical
segmentation tasks. Through the application of relative approximation bounds,
we show that all surrogates are equivalent up to a multiplicative factor, and
that no optimal weighting of cross-entropy exists to approximate Dice or
Jaccard measures. We validate these findings empirically and show that, while
it is important to opt for one of the target metric surrogates rather than a
cross-entropy-based loss, the choice of the surrogate does not make a
statistical difference on a wide range of medical segmentation tasks.

The book opens in autumn of 1558, just after death of Mary I, and bells are heralding fact that Mary's half-sister, Elizabeth, is now queen. The book is told from four main perspectives: Elizabeth I's; William Cecil's, the queen's main advisor; Robert Dudley, queen's favourite; and Amy Robsart's, who is Robert Dudley's wife. Robert Dudley returns to court upon Elizabeth's coronation, and Amy hopes that his ambitions will not get him into trouble. During Mary's reign, Dudley was kept in the Tower of London, his father and brother were executed, and another brother died in Calais. However, her hopes for the quiet life soon die, as Elizabeth and Robert become closer and more intimate. Elizabeth has inherited bankrupt and rebellious country, in turmoil as a result of the previous two monarch's reigns. Her advisor, William Cecil, warns that she will only survive if she marries a strong prince, but only man that Elizabeth desires is her childhood friend, and married man, Robert Dudley. Robert is sure that he can reclaim his destiny at Elizabeth's side. And as queen and courtier fall in love, Dudley begins to contemplate impossible - setting aside his loving wife to marry the young Elizabeth...

Medical image segmentation is an essential prerequisite for developing
healthcare systems, especially for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. On
various medical image segmentation tasks, the u-shaped architecture, also known
as U-Net, has become the de-facto standard and achieved tremendous success.
However, due to the intrinsic locality of convolution operations, U-Net
generally demonstrates limitations in explicitly modeling long-range
dependency. Transformers, designed for sequence-to-sequence prediction, have
emerged as alternative architectures with innate global self-attention
mechanisms, but can result in limited localization abilities due to
insufficient low-level details. In this paper, we propose TransUNet, which
merits both Transformers and U-Net, as a strong alternative for medical image
segmentation. On one hand, the Transformer encodes tokenized image patches from
a convolution neural network (CNN) feature map as the input sequence for
extracting global contexts. On the other hand, the decoder upsamples the
encoded features which are then combined with the high-resolution CNN feature
maps to enable precise localization.
  We argue that Transformers can serve as strong encoders for medical image
segmentation tasks, with the combination of U-Net to enhance finer details by
recovering localized spatial information. TransUNet achieves superior
performances to various competing methods on different medical applications
including multi-organ segmentation and cardiac segmentation. Code and models
are available at https://github.com/Beckschen/TransUNet.

The relevance and importance of contextualizing data analytics is described.
Qualitative characteristics might form context of quantitative analysis.
Topics that are at issue include: contrast, baselining, secondary data sources,
supplementary data sources, dynamic and heterogeneous data. In geometric data
analysis, especially with the Correspondence Analysis platform, various case
studies are both experimented with, and are reviewed. In such aspects as
paradigms followed, and technical implementation, implicitly and explicitly, an
important point made is the major relevance of such work for both burgeoning
analytical needs and for new analytical areas including Big Data analytics, and
so on. For general reader, it is aimed to display and describe, first of
all, the analytical outcomes that are subject to analysis here, and then
proceed to detail more quantitative outcomes that fully support the
analytics carried out.

Optimal surface segmentation is a state-of-the-art technique used for
segmentation of many globally optimal surfaces in volumetric databases. The
technique is commonly employed in many medical image segmentation systems.
Additionally, nodes in the graph based optimal surface segmentation technique also
encode evenly distributed orthogonal voxels of the volume. Thus the
segmentation cannot reach an accuracy higher than a single unit voxel, i.e.
the distance between three neighboring vertices in graph space. Segmentation accuracy
greater than a unit voxel is possible by exploiting partial volume information
in the voxels which will result in non-equidistant spacing between neighboring
graph vertices. This paper reports a generalized graph based multiple surface
segmentation technique with convex priors which can efficiently segment the target
surfaces in an irregularly sampled space. The proposed technique requires
non-equidistant spacing between the neighboring graph vertices to obtain subvoxel
segmentation accuracy by using the full volume information in the
voxels. The full volume information in the voxels is exploited by computing
a displacement field from the original volume data to find the
subvoxel-accurate centers within each voxel resulting in non-equidistant
spacing between the neighboring graph vertices. The smoothness of each surface
modeled as a vertex constraint determines the connectivity and regularity of the
surface. We employ an edge-based graph representation to incorporate the
appropriate parameters and the globally efficient solution is provided by
computing a minimum s-t cut. The proposed technique was tested on 10
intravascular multi-frame ultrasound image data for subvoxel segmentation
accuracy. In all situations, the method yielded very reliable findings. Our
technique can be easily extended to higher-dimensional segmentations.

This novel is narrated by Joe Oakes, a journalist who makes his living investigating reports of supernatural events. When a tourist’s inexplicable recording reveals a frightful half-human, half-beast, pacing the beach of a remote Scottish island, the local religious community, the Psychogenic Church of Psychic Healers, invites him to come and dispel the rumours of Satanism that have arisen from the recording. Oakes has met Pastor Dove before and has a standing promise to keep. However, his visit to the island elicits more questions than it answers. Why does the larger community not want him there? Why is no one talking about the strange creature that has been seen pacing the island? And what is behind the wood and the gorge that almost bisects the island, where there is a fence with rotting pig heads on the posts? But above all, what has happened to Pastor Dove, who has not been seen for years and who is never spoken of? Joe’s visit to the island and its terrifying ending are only the beginning of the island’s hold on his life.

This paper presents a method for segmenting iris images obtained from the
deceased subjects, by    training a deep convolutional  neural network (DCNN)
designed for the purpose  of semantic segmentation.  Post-mortem iris  recognition
has recently emerged as an alternative, or additional, method useful in
forensic analysis. At the same time it poses many new challenges  from the
technological standpoint, one of them being the image  segmentation stage, which
has  proven    difficult to be reliably executed by conventional iris recognition
methods. Our approach   is based on the SegNet architecture, fine-tuned with
1,300 manually segmented post-mortem iris images taken  from the
Warsaw-BioBase-Post-Mortem-Iris v1.0 database. The experiments presented  in
this paper show  that this data-driven solution is able  to learn  specific
deformations present in post-mortem samples,  which are  missing  from alive
irises,  and offers a considerable improvement over the state-of-the-art,
conventional segmentation algorithm (OSIRIS): the Intersection over Union (IoU)
metric was  improved  from 73.6% (for OSIRIS)   to 83% (for DCNN-based presented in
this paper)  averaged over subject-disjoint, multiple  splits of the  data into
train and test subsets. This paper offers the first known to us method of
automatic processing of post-mortem iris  images. We  offer source codes with the
trained DCNN that perform end-to-end segmentation of post-mortem iris  images,
as  described in this  paper. Also,  we offer binary masks corresponding to manual
segmentation of samples  from   Warsaw-BioBase-Post-Mortem-Iris v1.0  database to
facilitate development  of alternative methods for post-mortem iris
segmentation.

Tikkirey "Tiki" Frost lives on the planet Quarry, poorly adapted for human life and stricken with poverty. Due to the planet's high radioactivity, the inhabitants of Quarry are forced to live in a protective dome and pay for food and air, or "social support". Unemployment is a major problem on Quarry. In fact, one's ability to obtain a job depends on the quality of his or her neuroshunt implant, allowing direct mind-to-machine connection. Tikkirey's parents' neuroshunts have become obsolete and they have no money for an upgrade. His father has been unemployed for years, and his mother makes a pittance. Incapable of paying for their social support, Tikkirey's parents are forced to invoke their "constitutional right to commit suicide." For that, Tikkirey's social support is extended by 7 years, during which he can get education and find a job, as his neuroshunt is above the local standard. If his parents forgo their "constitutional right", the entire family will be evicted from the Dome. The life expectancy outside the Dome is 1-2 years. After losing his parents, Tikkirey decides to leave Quarry by any means neccessary. As such, he signs up on an interstellar ore transport as a "calculation module" — a wetware computer used for complex calculations at faster-than-light speeds, as normal computers fail to work. A calculation module remains in hibernation, most of the time, while a stream of data is shunted through his brain. While this is a highly paid position, continuous misuse of the brain atrophies the frontal lobe, causing the person to lose his free will. After the expiration of the standard five-year contract, 97% of calculation modules are incapable of making their own decisions and continue flying for the rest of their lives. The other 3% manage to muster enough willpower to leave the ship (2%) or cancel the contract before time is up (1%); however, even they have to spend years relearning to make even the simplest decisions (e.g. a simple choice of soft drink is an extremely difficult process for them). After regaining consciousness on the beatiful and wealthy planet of New Kuwait, Tikkirey demands to cancel his contract and leave the ship. He imediately finds out that a clause in the contract prevents him from doing just that, as he must pay off his 150,000 credit insurance policy, which will require Tikkirey to serve another 1.5 years on the ship. The contract is specifically written to prevent calculation modules from using ships as free rides. Fortunately, Tikkirey finds out that the crew took pity on the boy and broke the law by not getting him an insurance policy. He receives his earned credits and leaves the ship. He then takes a taxi and gets a room at a cheap hotel. He then hits another snag: his money will only last him about a week. New Kuwait's laws require local permanent residency for employment, but the process of obtaining it takes at least six months. At the hotel, Tikkirey meets Lion, a boy his age, who was born and grew up on a space station. The next day, Tikkirey encounters and befriends a mysterious man named Captain Stas, who turns out to be a phage from the planet Avalon. Phages are knight-like members of an organization whose goal is to rid the Empire of its enemies. Unlike the rational humans around them, phages are encouraged to listen with their hearts. A phage is genetically engineered to be stronger and faster than any normal human. He is capable of using something called an "imperative voice", causing most humans to follow his instructions without question (similer to the Voice from Frank Herbert's novel Dune). A phage's weapon of choice is a multi-functional semi-intelligent plasma whip, chosen not for its deadliness but for its psychological effect. The phages' mission, abilities, and moral code have earned them the nickname "jedi", which they tend to dislike, as it trivializes the phages' purpose. Stas is on a mission to investigate the suspicious activity on New Kuwait of agents from the planet Iney ("frost" in Russian). Iney has already "peacefully" allied with several other Imperial worlds and is gaining in strength, threatening the stability of the Empire. Before Stas or Tikkirey can do anything, most of the population of New Kuwait suddenly falls asleep. Tikkirey and Stas are one of the few still awake. Stas takes the boy and, at Tikkirey's request, the unconscious Lion with him on his ship. They are able to launch before the population awakes and announces its allegaince with Iney. With some quick thinking, Tikkirey connects Lion's brain to the datastream of the ship, temporarily turning him into a calculation module. The plan works, and Lion awakes shortly after. However, his free will is gone. Stas takes the boys to his homeplanet of Avalon, where the phages' headquarters are located. Tikkirey is hired by the phages to work in support role, while he takes care of Lion. Basically, Tikkirey is forced to tell Lion to do allmost everything, hoping that he may one day get better. He also makes friends with his neighbors, a brother and a sister of a slightly younger age. One day, Tikkirey is asked by his supervisor to destroy a faulty plasma whip, which refuses to bond with any phage. To Tikkirey's suprise, the whip bonds to him, and he refuses to destroy the semi-living device. That same day, his neighbors invite him and Lion to go camping at a nearby lake. Since it is wintertime in that part of Avalon, the lake is frozen over. The teenagers (except for Lion) begin to ice skate, but ice cracks under Tikkirey, and he falls into the water. He attempts to get out by using the whip but to no avail. Surprisingly, Lion snaps out of his daze and saves Tikkirey. Stas arrives with paramedics and explains that the whip was a test of loyalty, which Tikkirey has failed. Tikkirey shows that the whip bonded to him, which surprises the phage, as this has never happened before. Tikkirey and Lion are taken to the phage headquarters, where Lion is given a clean bill of health by a psychiatrist. Lion explains that, during the time he was asleep, he has lived an entire lifetime as a citizen of Iney. The boys find out that the phages are planning on sending them back to New Kuwait to conduct an investigation as to how Iney is controlling the population. Tikkirey and Lion are dropped in a pod made of a special form of ice, which melts on landing, leaving no trace. However, the boys are quickly captured by a team of girls armed with crossbows. They are escorted to their base camp, where Tikkirey encounters a disabled old man he met while escaping from New Kuwait. The girls are members of a former hip hop dancing troupe who have become guerrilla fighters. They help the boys sneak into the city, where Lion is reunited with his family, who all behave like a stereotypical perfect TV family. Tikkirey and Lion are sent to a boarding school "to learn to serve the society better." Everything appears to be going well, except that the boys know they are under surveillance. One night, the old man's daughter Natasha sneaks into their room and informs them that Iney counter-intelligence is following their every move. They decide to escape and hide in a school located in a poor district. They are able, for a time, to remain undetected by the Iney. Once, however, Natasha introduces Tikkirey to another girl, who claims to also be an agent for the phages. She informs Tikkirey that a wealthy Imperial industrialist has arrived on New Kuwait and that he is secretly working with Iney against the Empire. The girl orders Tikkirey to execute the industrialist and his teenage daughter. While morally disagreeing with the girl, Tikkirey decides to go through with it. Tikkirey, Lion, and Natasha sneak into the villa where the industrialist is being treated as an honored guest. However, upon attempting to ambush the man and his daughter, Tikkirey is surprised to learn that the industrialist is, in fact, Stas in disguise. His "daughter" is a young phage-in-training dressed as a girl. The real industrialist has been detained by the Imperial forces, and the phages have been sent in their stead. Stas imediately realizes that the girl who gave the execution order is an Iney agent, which means that their cover is blown. He decides to attempt to smuggle Tikkirey, Lion, and Natasha from New Kuwait in suitcases. There is one problem, however — due to a quirk of nature, FTL travel is lethal to human females (the reasoning behind this is not explained, although it is mentioned that a Y-chromosome is neccessary to survive an FTL jump). As such, Natasha must be placed into a cryogenic pod. Due to the shortage of space on the luxury transport, the dock workers decide to leave Tikkirey's suitcase in storage to be sent with the next ship. An old female dockworker decides to look inside and finds the boy. Instead of reporting him, however, the old lady feeds him and asks him to tell her what is happening. After hearing his story, Tikkirey asks her to contact Stas and tell him to freeze Natasha. When she comes back, the lady begins to explain certain unknown facts to Tikkirey. She explains that the president of Iney, a woman by the name of Inna Snow, is, in fact, a clone. At one point in time, a genetic genius named Edward Garlitsky has decided to fundamentally alter humanity for the better. For this purpose, he cloned himself into a woman named Ada Snezhinskaya, but their views on the means of achieving the change were radically different: Edward wanted to act behind-the-scenes (according to the novel Genome, he became the father of specification), while Ada wanted to directly alter the current social and political structure of the Empire. For that purpose, Ada created thousands of clones of herself and of Edward and spread them throughout the Empire (at that time, it was common practice for parents to buy fetuses). The first names of the female clones were always four letters long with a double consonant in the middle, while the last name was in some way related to snow (e.g. Inna Snow, Anna Neige). Sooner or later, most of the clones were tracked down and offered to have the collective memory of the clones imprinted on them. Most agreed. They all began to set themselves up in certain key political positions. Eventually, Inna Snow discovered a way of using neuroshunts to slowly download a dormant program into people's brains. A certain signal would then trigger the program, which would allow the affected people to live out entire lifetimes in their heads. While each person's "dream life" was different, several constants remained the same: Inna Snow and Iney are good, the Empire and the Emperor are bad. The medium for implanting the program was chosen to be the many TV series produced on Iney and watched throughout the Empire. After hearing this, Tikkirey realizes that the old lady is Ada Snezhinskaya, who reveals that Tikkirey Frost is himself a clone of Edward Garlitsky. Despite this realization, Tikkirey attempts to kill Ada with a whip, but he only wounds her and gets captured by Iney forces. Finding himself in a prison cell with Stas, the phage-in-training, Lion, Natasha, and her grandfather, Tikkirey questions Stas and finds out that Stas knew about him being a clone. The group is then taken to a factory to meet Ada and Inna, where, after a verbal joust, Stas reveals that the Empire has begun a massive invasion of all Iney-occupied worlds, using a modified version of Inna Snow's program to remove Iney's propaganda from the affected people's minds. In a last-ditch effort to save herself and her plan, Ada uses the imperative voice to order Tikkirey and Natasha to jump off the catwalk into a pool of strong solvent. Natasha's grandfather sacrifices himself to save his granddaughter and push both Ada and Inna off the catwalk. Stas uses his own imperative voice to override Ada's order and frees the teenagers. With the threat of Iney gone and the clones in custody, Stas offers to take Tikkirey back to Avalon. However, Tikkirey first makes a stop at Quarry to get two of his friends off that rock. As a side note, he mentions that a genetic cure has been found to allow women to safely traverse FTL hyperchannels without the use of cryogenics. ru:Танцы на снегу (роман) zh:雪舞者
